theses.subject: Gold Miners
theses.thesis: Gold Miners is the confirmed leader (rank 1, eligible) with broadest participation (breadth 0.933) and durability_bar 0.66, the highest among scorable themes; this supports staying with the prevailing leadership rather than fading it, while the validated absolute-trend gate (eligible=true) provides the drawdown-control leg. theses.dissent: Hurst tag is 'mixed' and r10 is slightly negative (-0.0054), meaning the trend may be stalling; cross-sectional rank has rank-IC ~0, so leadership persistence is not a validated edge.
